Definition: plain, Sharon, the name of a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: n m; 1) plain, level; Sharon = "a plain"; n pr loc; 2) the district lying between the mountains of central Palestine and the Mediterranean Sea and north of Joppa; 3) a district on the east of the Jordan around Gilead and Bashan
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
